records.text: Owens said private group-chat messages show that before Kirk's death she warned Charlie Kirk and Tyler Bowyer that she did not trust Shaffer Security.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: I had the messages to prove it. I ranted at him and Tyler Bowyer in a group chat. ... saying that I did not trust Shaper Security. ... I have it in writing.

verification.notes: Owens said she had contemporaneous group-chat messages documenting her distrust of Shaffer Security, but the complete messages, metadata, and recipients' authentication were not presented in this episode or located in an independently accessible source.
